newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador, Peru to resume border talks April 15.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador, Peru to resume border talks April 15.

text.p: Envoys from Ecuador and Peru will resume border talks in the Brazilian capital Brasilia on April 15, the Ecuadorean Foreign Ministry said on Monday.

"In Brasilia we will hold important talks aimed at reaching a global and definitive solution to all points of contention, which will be disussed on a case-by-case basis," the ministry said in a statement.
It called for "a constructive dialogue" with Peru.
The meeting was twice postponed in December and February because of the Lima hostage crisis and political scandals in Quito.
Ecuador and Peru, which fought a brief border war in 1995, are holding peace talks under the 1942 Rio Protocol monitored by Argentina, Brazil, Chile and the United States.
The five-member Ecuadorean delegation will be headed by the country's former ambassador in Washington, Edgar Teran.
